entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I hope someone can help me. I need to make a return.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. I can definitely look into that for you. Can you tell me your name and the item you're calling about?
It's Sarah Miller. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes a little while ago.
Okay, Sarah, I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I just... they're not working for me. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats over and over, but no matter what I do, they give me the most painful blisters. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but I just can't wear them. I really, really needed this money back.
I'm truly sorry to hear that they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see they arrived 48 days ago.
And I have good news for you. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process a full refund for those cycling shoes.
Oh, you can? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Charlie. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
